headline: Goa Gets Two New AYUSH Hospitals
summary: Goa is set to receive two new AYUSH district hospitals, alongside the operationalization of 16 free dialysis centres across the region. These additions aim to bolster public healthcare accessibility.

headline: Old Hospicio Renovation to Ease Bed Crunch
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the renovation of the old Hospicio building will help alleviate the bed shortage at the South Goa District Hospital. The upgraded facility aims to improve patient accommodation.

headline: Margao AYUSH Hospital to Open Soon
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the new AYUSH Integrated Hospital in Margao will become fully functional within a month. The facility is expected to enhance traditional healthcare services in the area.

headline: Green Tribunal Stays Mormugao Port Project
summary: The National Green Tribunal has stayed clearances granted for the Mormugao Port's channel deepening project in Goa. The decision halts ongoing preparations pending further legal review.

headline: Mormugao Port Secures Private 5G Licence
summary: Mormugao port has become the country's first major port to secure authorization for a private 5G network. This technology upgrade aims to streamline port operations and digital infrastructure.

headline: Mormugao Port Gains Private 5G Network
summary: Goa's Mormugao Port has officially become India's first major port to secure private 5G network authorization. The deployment is expected to significantly boost technological efficiency at the facility.

headline: South Goa Advocates Protest Revenue Delays
summary: Advocates in South Goa staged protests over persistent delays and systemic corruption in revenue offices. They are demanding immediate administrative reforms to clear pending case backlogs.

headline: Sawant Warns of Strict Action Over Bribes
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant warned officials of potential suspension and termination if found taking bribes for processing mutation files. The government aims to crack down on corruption in land revenue departments.

headline: South Goa Lawyers Protest Case Delays
summary: Lawyers in South Goa held demonstrations to protest against corruption and prolonged delays in mutation and partition cases. The legal fraternity demands immediate transparency and efficiency in revenue offices.

headline: CJP Goa Disowns Anti-Hindutva Slogan
summary: Following a stern warning of legal action from Chief Minister Pramod Sawant, CJP Goa has officially disowned controversial anti-Hindutva slogans raised during a protest. Authorities had launched a probe into the incident.

headline: Probe Ordered Into Protest Slogans
summary: Goa CM Pramod Sawant confirmed that an active investigation is underway regarding the provocative slogans raised during a recent protest. The state government has vowed strict action against those responsible.

headline: Congress Condemns Anti-Hindu Slogans
summary: The Congress party has strongly condemned the anti-Hindu slogans raised during a recent protest in Goa. They have formally demanded a comprehensive investigation by the Director General of Police.

headline: Thailand Trip Cheaper Than Goa Vacation
summary: Travel creators have claimed that their Rs 50,000 trip to Thailand cost less than a comparable vacation in Goa. The comparison has sparked discussions online regarding local tourism pricing.

headline: Goa-Pune Traffic Diversion via Nipani
summary: Authorities have issued traffic updates and route diversions for commuters traveling from Goa to Pune via Nipani due to ongoing protests. Motorists are advised to plan their journeys accordingly.

headline: ISL Records High Opening Week Viewership
summary: The Indian Super League drew 77 million views during its opening week of the season. This strong start highlights the growing popularity of the football tournament.

headline: Worker Found Murdered at Kala Academy
summary: A worker was found murdered at the Kala Academy premises in Panaji. Local police have launched an investigation to apprehend the perpetrators.

headline: Anjuna Cottage Offers Peaceful Seaside Stay
summary: A traveler highlighted a peaceful month-long stay at an Anjuna cottage where the ocean served as a natural retreat. The serene getaway underscores Goa's appeal for relaxation.

headline: Strong Registrations for Goa AI Conclave
summary: The Goa AI Tech Conclave portal has received strong registration numbers ahead of its upcoming flagship event. The conference is scheduled to be held at the INOX Courtyard in Panaji.

headline: Insights From Goa's Spring Census
summary: Recent data from the spring census sheds light on various demographic and ecological trends across Goa. The findings offer a comprehensive look at the region's current state.

headline: Mapusa Holds Floriculture Workshop
summary: ZAO Mapusa and ATMA North Goa jointly organized a floriculture workshop alongside a traditional Phati-making competition. The event aimed to promote local agricultural crafts and farming skills.

headline: Goa to Get Second Medical College
summary: Goa is set to establish its second government medical college, which will introduce 50 new MBBS seats starting from the 2027-28 academic year. The expansion aims to address the rising demand for medical education.

headline: Rohan Khaunte Discusses Goa's Tech Future
summary: Goa minister Rohan Khaunte outlined the government's vision for transforming the state into India's next tech hub through AI investments and job creation. He emphasized ongoing initiatives to attract global technology companies.

headline: Vibrant Goa Summit Connects MSMEs
summary: The upcoming Vibrant Goa summit is scheduled to connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers. The event aims to boost international trade opportunities for Goan businesses.

headline: Restaurant Week India 2026 Guide Released
summary: Restaurant Week India 2026 has announced its complete guide, featuring participating dining spots across Delhi, Mumbai, Goa, and other major culinary destinations. Food enthusiasts can look forward to curated menus and special experiences.

headline: Bigg Boss 20: Gullu Addresses Dispute
summary: On Bigg Boss 20, contestant Gullu revealed the reasons behind Nakul bringing up a past dispute involving Goa. The discussion has stirred fresh conversations among housemates and fans alike.

headline: Goa CM Slams CJP Protestors Over Slogans
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant strongly criticized protestors linked to the CJP over anti-Hindu slogans raised in Panaji. He has ordered a thorough probe to identify those responsible for the communal tension.

headline: ICA Conclave 2026 Concludes in Goa
summary: The ICA Conclave 2026 has officially wrapped up in Goa, focusing on the journey from being an author to an authority figure. The event brought together writers, publishers, and industry experts.

headline: Vibrant Goa Summit Targets Global Buyers
summary: The Vibrant Goa Summit aims to facilitate direct business connections between 220 Goan MSMEs and more than 300 international buyers. The initiative intends to expand global market access for local enterprises.

headline: Telangana Police Busts Goa Narcotics Ring
summary: Telangana Police successfully busted a Goa-based narcotics network, resulting in three arrests and the seizure of Rs 1.5 lakh worth of drugs. The operation followed a coordinated multi-day surveillance effort.

headline: Konkani Prime News Broadcast
summary: Prudent Media broadcasted its daily news roundup in Konkani, covering local events, administrative updates, and regional developments across Goa.

headline: MPA Withdraws Baina Beach Lease Proposal
summary: Following significant public backlash, the Mormugao Port Authority has withdrawn its controversial 30-year Baina Beach lease proposal. Local residents and stakeholders had strongly opposed the long-term commercial plan.

headline: Mixed Signals Over Smart Meters in Goa
summary: While smart meters have received official clearance in Goa, conflicting statements from a state minister and an engineer have caused public confusion. The rollout continues to face mixed administrative messaging.

headline: Probe Ordered Into Temple Land Transfer
summary: The local Mamlatdar has ordered a special audit and formal inquiry into the controversial land transfer associated with the Chandreshwar temple. Authorities are examining records to detect any procedural irregularities.

headline: Goa Foundation Opposes Tamnar Project
summary: The Goa Foundation has formally urged the National Tiger Conservation Authority to halt clearances for the Tamnar project within a proposed tiger reserve. Environmentalists argue the initiative threatens local wildlife habitats.

headline: Drug Supplier Arrested After Goa Hunt
summary: Telangana Police arrested a wanted drug supplier following a grueling seven-day manhunt across Goa. The accused was successfully apprehended with the assistance of local intelligence.

headline: Goa Unveils Stray Dog Management Plan
summary: The Goa government has introduced a comprehensive roadmap aimed at managing stray dog populations across coastal areas. The policy focuses on vaccination, sterilization, and community safety.

headline: Dry Monsoon Impacts Goa Paddy Yield
summary: Goa experienced its driest monsoon in 50 years, severely impacting approximately 25 hectares of paddy crops. Farmers are facing agricultural losses due to the prolonged dry spell.

headline: Konkani Prime News Recap
summary: Prudent Media aired its regular Konkani language news bulletin, summarizing key regional stories and government announcements from around the state.

headline: HC Warns Panchayats Over PoSH Delays
summary: The High Court has issued a stern warning to the Goa Directorate of Panchayats regarding ongoing delays in establishing Internal Complaints Committees under the PoSH Act. Authorities have been urged to expedite compliance.

headline: Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary Nears Opening
summary: With roughly 70 percent of the development work completed, the inauguration of the Dr Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary is expected within the next 10 days. The eco-tourism site aims to attract nature enthusiasts and bird watchers.

headline: Goa Drafts CCTV Policy for Panchayats
summary: The Goa government has drafted a new CCTV retention policy requiring village panchayats to install and maintain at least five cameras each. The measure is designed to improve local surveillance and village security.

headline: Slow Start for Calangute-Candolim Shacks
summary: Beach shacks in the Calangute-Candolim belt are experiencing a slow start to the season. Operators attribute the sluggish beginning to delayed approvals and fluctuating tourist turnouts.

headline: Goa Blends Fitness With Tourism
summary: Goa is promoting a new tourism trend that combines fitness routines with recreational getaways, featuring running events and wellness retreats. The initiative targets health-conscious travelers looking for active holidays.

headline: Multi-Crore Scam Run From Goa Villa
summary: Police revealed how a group of 12 young men successfully orchestrated a multi-crore financial scam while operating out of a luxury villa in Goa. Investigators uncovered the elaborate setup following a targeted raid.

headline: Goa Holds 'Sarkar Tumchya Dari' Event
summary: The Goa government is hosting its 'Sarkar Tumchya Dari' public grievance redressal initiative to resolve citizen complaints locally. Officials will be present to address community concerns directly.

headline: Road Trip Update: Bengaluru to North Goa
summary: Travelers have shared detailed route guides, road conditions, and recommended stops for driving from Bengaluru to North Goa. The updates aim to assist tourists planning road trips to the coastal state.

headline: Goa Tops Festive Travel Search Trends
summary: Recent festive travel trends for 2026 indicate that Goa remains one of the top holiday search destinations for Indian travelers, alongside international spots like Bangkok and Phuket.

headline: Panaji Temperatures Cross 37°C
summary: Panaji recorded temperatures exceeding 37°C for the second consecutive day, bringing intense heat to the region. Residents are advised to stay hydrated as warm weather persists.

headline: Goa Plans Water Use Curbs Amid Dry Spell
summary: In response to deficient rainfall, the Goa government is planning strict curbs on non-essential water consumption. Authorities urge residents to conserve water as reservoir levels face pressure.

headline: Labour Shortage Delays Trawler Operations
summary: Fishing trawlers in Goa remain anchored months after the official fishing ban was lifted due to an acute labour shortage. Boat owners are struggling to find adequate crew members to resume operations.
